Eliminates repeated O(M) SQLite position scans and repeated O(M) SELECT_OWED_ENTRY_BYTES sums of oversized CDC entries in composeCdcShipRange by maintaining a per-entry owed byte tally on the ledger connection owner (src/partition/partition-cdc-obligation-ledger.js) updated via RETURNING log_index, octet_length(event_json) on MARK_DELIVERED and finalized through explicit afterCommit (commitOwedEntryByteTallies) and afterRollback (rollbackOwedEntryByteTallies) lifecycle hooks in applyCdcAcknowledgementCommand (src/partition/partition-cdc-obligation.js) without modifying the SQLite schema, short-circuiting owedEntriesFrom on oversized entries to O(1) position queries per single-event shipment, paging non-oversized multi-row entries by BOUND.DRIVE_PAGE_ROWS in owedEntryPositionsAfter, paging firstReadyRow by BOUND.DRIVE_PAGE_ROWS, and using readOwedCdcObligationPositions in drainPendingHydratedObligations so hydrated-prefix acknowledgement never reads event_json payloads.
